# discord_bulk_ban (Action)

Bans up to 200 users from a server in one request, for example after a raid. Users Discord could not ban, or who were already banned, are reported in a warning; the action fails only when nobody could be banned. Use `discord_ban` for bans Terraform keeps in place. Requires the Ban Members and Manage Server permissions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run with: terraform apply -invoke=action.discord_bulk_ban.raid
action "discord_bulk_ban" "raid" {
  config {
    server_id              = var.server_id
    user_ids               = ["456789012345678901", "567890123456789012"]
    delete_message_seconds = 3600
    audit_log_reason       = "Raid"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).
- `user_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the users to ban, at most 200.

### Optional

- `audit_log_reason` (String) Reason recorded in the server's audit log and on each ban, overriding the provider's `audit_log_reason`. Up to 512 characters.
- `delete_message_seconds` (Number) Number of seconds of each user's message history to delete, from 0 to 604800 (7 days). Defaults to 0.
